messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action to the one demonstrated in the motion reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please continue from the result of the first hair color change and make the following change to that video: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's action to the one demonstrated in the reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still, then turns his head and body to the side, raises one hand to his chin, and crosses his arms before returning to a neutral standing pose.","camera":"Static, eye-level full-body shot from the front.","clothing":"Light blue cable-knit sweater, blue-gray slim trousers, and brown ankle boots.","hair_color":"Bright yellow-green.","hairstyle":"Short, flat-topped hair with a small tuft sticking up at the front.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build and light skin stands in the center of the frame.","scene":"An outdoor urban plaza at dusk with tall buildings, neon signs, construction cranes, and a wet tiled ground reflecting the ambient light."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output character now performs a similar sequence: standing, turning head/body to the side, raising a hand to the chin, crossing arms, then returning to a neutral standing pose. The character's yellow-green hair, light blue sweater, blue-gray trousers, brown boots, and urban plaza scene remain consistent, and the camera remains static.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's action with the motion shown in the reference video while preserving identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Exact match of subtle timing and body orientation to the reference motion cannot be fully verified from the sampled frames.
